reflections.title: Following Christ in the Home

reflect.text: When Jesus gives us new life, that change shows up first inside our own homes. Following Christ is not just about what we do at church. It calls us to put others first and turn away from our own selfish desires in daily family life. These teachings are lasting commands rooted in the good news of Jesus, not old customs meant only for the past.

The apostle Paul explains what this looks like for each family member. Wives are asked to yield to their husbands, showing that equal worth and submission can live together peacefully, just as they do within the Trinity. Husbands are commanded to love their wives gently without being harsh. Parents are also told not to provoke or frustrate their children, keeping them from losing heart.

Children honor the Lord when they obey their parents in everything. How we act each day brings either honor or dishonor to our parents. Submitting to their guidance pleases God and leads to spiritual blessing, while going our own way brings danger. Even when we grow into adults, we continue to honor our parents by listening to their advice and treating them with respect.

questions: How can you put others first in your home this week instead of insisting on your own way?
In what practical ways can you show honor and respect to your parents or family today?
reflections.prayer: Lord, help us to live out our faith in our daily family life. Teach us to lay down our selfishness and treat one another with gentle love. May our homes bring honor and pleasure to you each day. Amen.

D1.author: Adrian Rogers
